cs.t: I have a dahon mariner bike. I like it even though I lack the boat it’s supposed to pair with (I put it in my car).  It doesn’t fold as small as the bromton, but I think the wheels are bigger..  it’s useful to have the bike when traveling, dropping car at shop. I think I like the Danone better than my brothers bromton e-bike (which he won in a raffle.. lucky). Ebikes are great though.
cs.th: Folding bicycle small enough to fit in hand luggage
